goal: Defeat Brock for the Boulder Badge

subgoals.goal_text: Travel back to Pallet Town to deliver Oak's Parcel.
Enter Professor Oak's lab and give him the parcel.
Travel north through Viridian City and enter Viridian Forest.
Battle wild Pokemon in Viridian Forest to raise Charmander's level.
Exit Viridian Forest and enter Pewter City.
Visit the Pewter City Pokemon Center to fully heal the party.
Enter the Pewter City Gym to challenge the leader.
Defeat Brock in battle to earn the Boulder Badge.
